name: LD1117S50TR
title: 800 mA low-dropout positive voltage regulator, fixed and adjustable
summary: The LD1117 is a positive linear regulator with an NPN pass transistor that delivers up to 800 mA with about 1 V of dropout. It comes in fixed 1.2, 1.8, 2.5, 3.3 and 5.0 V versions and an adjustable version with a 1.25 V reference, in SOT-223, SO-8, DPAK and TO-220. Output tolerance is ±1 % at 25 °C and 2 % over temperature; it is stable with a 10 µF output capacitor and has current and thermal limiting. LD1117S50TR is the 5.0 V, 0 to 125 °C part in SOT-223 on tape and reel.
key_figures: 1 V typ at 100 mA, 1.10 V typ at 800 mA

circuits.title: Application circuit, 1.2 V version
circuits.description: The 1.2 V fixed part with a 100 nF capacitor across the input and a 10 µF capacitor across the output. A 120 Ω resistor runs from the output to ground beside the output capacitor.

circuits.title: Application circuit, other fixed voltages
circuits.description: Any fixed version from 1.8 V up: 100 nF across the input, 10 µF across the output, ground pin to the common return.

circuits.title: Negative supply
circuits.description: A 5 V part makes -5 V from a floating transformer winding. The winding feeds a four-diode bridge; the bridge's positive corner charges a 10 µF input capacitor and feeds IN. The regulator's OUT is the system ground, and its GND pin, the bridge's negative corner and the bottom of both capacitors form the -5 V output. A 100 µF capacitor, positive side on ground, holds the output.
notes: VOUT is -5 V with respect to GND.
The secondary winding floats: nothing ties it to ground.

circuits.title: Circuit for increasing output voltage
circuits.description: A 5 V part whose GND pin returns to ground through a 1 kΩ variable resistor. A 10 µF capacitor, marked with an asterisk, runs from the GND pin to ground beside the resistor. The input has 10 µF and the output 100 µF. With the input above 12 V the output covers 5 V to 10 V.
notes: VIN above 12 V; VOUT 5 V to 10 V.

circuits.title: Voltage regulator with reference
circuits.description: A 5 V part stacked on a zener: the zener, cathode at the GND pin and anode to ground, raises the ground pin to 5 V, which is also brought out as a 5 V output, and the regulator's OUT sits 5 V above it at 10 V. 10 µF at the input, 100 µF at the output; the input must be above 11.5 V.
notes: VIN above 11.5 V; VOUT 10 V; V5 is the 5 V output at the ground pin.

circuits.title: Battery backed-up regulated supply
circuits.description: Two 5 V parts share one output. U1 takes VIN through a series diode and has a 50 Ω resistor from its GND pin to ground. A second diode and a series resistor, selected for the charge current, run from VIN to a 6.5 V battery; the battery feeds U2, whose GND pin is grounded. The output is 5.2 V on line power and 5.0 V on the battery. Each regulator input has 10 µF; the joined output has 100 µF.
notes: VOUT is 5.2 V on line power and 5.0 V on the battery.

circuits.title: Post-regulated dual supply
circuits.description: A switching regulator drives a transformer with three secondaries, each rectified by an STTH302 into 470 µF. The first gives a typical 3.3 V and is the switcher's feedback path. The second feeds U1 for +5 V. The third feeds U2, whose OUT is tied to ground; U2's GND pin and that winding's return form the -5 V output. Each regulator output has 10 µF and a 1N4002, cathode on the more positive side, across it.

parts.note: primary P1-P2; secondaries S1, S2, S3

notes: The 3.3 V output is a typical value; +5 V and -5 V are each rated 0.5 A.

circuits.title: Adjustable output voltage application
circuits.description: The adjustable part set by two resistors: R1, 120 Ω, from OUT to ADJ carries VREF; R2 from ADJ to ground sets the output. 10 µF at the input and 10 µF at the output.

circuits.title: Adjustable output voltage application with improved ripple rejection
circuits.description: The adjustable circuit with a 10 µF capacitor added across R2, from ADJ to ground, which raises ripple rejection.

equations.name: Output voltage, adjustable version
equations.expr: VOUT = VREF + R2 × (IADJ + VREF / R1) = VREF × (1 + R2 / R1) + R2 × IADJ

where.VREF: reference held from OUT to ADJ, 1.25 ± 0.012 V
where.R1: resistor from OUT to ADJ, usually 120 Ω
where.IADJ: adjust pin current, 60 µA typ, 120 µA max

equations.note: With R2 a few kΩ the R2 × IADJ term is small and VOUT = VREF × (1 + R2 / R1).

operation.text: An NPN transistor is the pass element, and nearly all of the quiescent current ends up in the load. Dropout is about 1 V.
A 10 µF output capacitor is the minimum needed for stability.
The output is trimmed on chip to ±1 % at 25 °C and is held within 2 % over the full temperature range.
Current limiting and thermal shutdown are built in.

Fixed outputs of 1.2, 1.8, 2.5, 3.3 and 5.0 V and an adjustable version with a 1.25 V reference. The adjustable part uses the same pinout as other standard adjustable regulators. The 2.85 V device suits SCSI-2 active termination. Standard versions are rated for junction temperatures of 0 to 125 °C, C versions for -40 to 125 °C.
The adjustable and 1.2 V versions specify a minimum load current of 2 mA typ, 5 mA max. The 1.2 V figures are taken with 120 Ω between OUT and GND.

The reference between OUT and ADJ is 1.25 ± 0.012 V and is temperature stabilised. The adjust pin draws 60 µA typ, 120 µA max, varying by 1 µA typ, 5 µA max, over line and load. The usual R1 is 120 Ω.
Load regulation depends on Kelvin connection of the divider: R1 sits next to the OUT and ADJ pins, and R2's ground end goes to the load's negative terminal by the shortest path.
A 10 µF electrolytic across R2 improves ripple rejection.
SOT-223, DPAK and TO-220 carry VOUT on their tab.
DPAK parts come in three outlines, from ST and from two subcontractors (Fujitsu and IDS); all three fit the same recommended footprint.
